integrity: The proof and standalone definition-level verifier are included. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts labeled vertex subsets and unordered partitions into three total perfect codes, for widths n >= 3 only. Existence is already in prior literature; claimed refinement is exhaustive classification and exact alternating multiplicities. Potentially equivalent unindexed work remains a priority risk.
title: Boundary-twist reversal for total perfect codes of cubic ladders
